figurative_meaning_en: Aristocratic or respectable family, wealthy people
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে বড়ঘরের ছেলে বলে সবাই তাকে সম্মান করে।
এই শহরে বড়ঘরের লোকজনের প্রভাব অনেক।
example_sentences_in_english: He is respected by everyone because he is from a big house family.
Big house people have a lot of influence in this city.
history: Refers to the tradition of large zamindar households in colonial and pre-colonial Bengal, symbolizing landed gentry and social hierarchy.
note: The idiom evokes the image of grand ancestral homes associated with elite families in Bengali society.
